name: shop
label: BFB Shop
on: Bricks' own shop elements and Bricks' Theme Styles, with WooCommerce active
job: what Shop 2.0 is: the Shop settings page and its sub-pages, the feature switches, which shop skill covers what, building a shop from Bricks' own containers, the requirements, and the shop's theme style groups

switches.label: Shop sorting
switches.summary: Order products by SKU, stock or sales, with sold-out products last.

switches.label: Promo tiles
switches.summary: A template of your own at chosen places in a product grid.

switches.label: Reviews loop
switches.summary: Product reviews as a query loop, so they can sit anywhere in any layout.

switches.label: Brands
switches.summary: The brand in the shop breadcrumbs, and brand tags for any element.

switches.label: EU price and product information
switches.summary: The lowest price of the last 30 days, the unit price, and the maker and safety details.

switches.label: Product page essentials
switches.summary: Product data for search engines on every Bricks product template, and a first gallery image that loads at once.

switches.label: Mini cart
switches.summary: A mini cart that works for keyboard and screen readers, with your own empty state.

switches.label: Account
switches.summary: Your own account pages, a page after login or logout, and confirm fields on registration.

switches.label: Filters
switches.summary: Collapsible categories in product filters, and filters that understand variations.

switches.label: Search insights
switches.summary: What shoppers search for, and the searches that found nothing.

switches.label: Variation data
switches.summary: Price, SKU, stock and any detail that follow the variation the shopper chooses, in any element.

switches.label: Shop loops
switches.summary: Best sellers, trending, top rated, new arrivals, recently viewed, bought before and more, as query loops.

switches.label: Shop data
switches.summary: Shop tags, conditions and interactions in Bricks' own pickers, right on cached pages.

switches.label: Product cards
switches.summary: Swatches and add to cart on product cards, and the variation picker's behaviour.

switches.label: Product tabs
switches.summary: Extra product tabs with content from a Bricks template, per product, category or tag.

switches.label: Gallery video
switches.summary: Video in Bricks' product gallery, played by the Video Player.

switches.label: Stock
switches.summary: Stock as a bar, and sold counts, following the variation.

switches.label: Reviews
switches.summary: Review photos, helpful votes and sorting on WooCommerce's reviews.

switches.label: Buying
switches.summary: The BFB Buy Now straight to the checkout, and catalogue mode with ask for a price.

switches.label: Product options
switches.summary: BFB Advanced Forms on the product page: options priced on the server and added with the product.

switches.label: Quantity breaks
switches.summary: A price table by quantity, the same on the page and in the cart.

switches.label: Delivery
switches.summary: Delivery estimates with a postcode check, and delivery dates and slots at checkout.

switches.label: Checkout rules
switches.summary: A fee or discount by payment method, and hiding other rates when shipping is free.

switches.label: Coupons
switches.summary: Bricks' coupon field anywhere, coupons from a link, and coupons that apply themselves.

switches.label: Cart lines
switches.summary: Save for later, and undo after removing an item in the mini cart.

switches.label: Share a cart
switches.summary: A link that rebuilds the cart on another device or for someone else.

switches.label: Checkout fields
switches.summary: Your own checkout fields, saved to the order and shown everywhere WooCommerce shows an order.

switches.label: Lists
switches.summary: The wishlist, compare and quote list engine, for guests and customers.

switches.label: Live cart
switches.summary: Parts of the page drawn again after every cart change, popups included.

switches.label: Order loops
switches.summary: The customer's orders and an order's items as query loops.

switches.label: Swatch filters
switches.summary: A swatch look for Bricks' attribute filters.

switches.label: Search
switches.summary: Recent and popular searches under Bricks' live search, and synonyms.

switches.label: Alerts
switches.summary: Back-in-stock and price-drop alerts through BFB Advanced Forms.

themeStyles.on: Bricks' Theme Styles (Bricks, Theme Styles), beside Bricks' own WooCommerce groups

css.selector: .woocommerce .button, body:not(.woocommerce) .product_type_variable, body:not(.woocommerce) .product_type_grouped, body:not(.woocommerce) .product_type_external, body:not(.woocommerce) .product_type_simple, body:not(.woocommerce) .brx-popup-content:not(.woocommerce) form.cart .single_add_to_cart_button, body:not(.woocommerce) .brxe-woocommerce-mini-cart .woocommerce-mini-cart__buttons .button

mainSeparator.label: Main buttons
mainSeparator.description: Add to cart, proceed to checkout, place order.

fieldSeparator.label: Fields
fieldSeparator.description: Text fields, selects and text areas.

wooTickSeparator.label: Tick boxes and radios
wooTickSeparator.description: WooCommerce's own, wherever it prints them.

css.value: 1px solid var(--bfbe-tick-line, var(--bfbe-line, color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 35%, transparent)))
